verbalization: Voxtalisib is implicated in the regulation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through a multi-step mechanism. The evidence suggests that Voxtalisib directly targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1A2, which in turn is a target of a complex compound, (1S,3R,8R,11S,12S,15R,16R)-15-[(2R,6S)-7-hydroxy-6-methyl-5-methylideneheptan-2-yl]-7,7,12,16-tetramethylpentacyclo[9.7.0.01,3.03,8.012,16]octadecan-6-one. This compound, in turn, targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential role for Voxtalisib in modulating the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through its interaction with the 1A2 transporter, which may serve as a bridge in the regulatory network. The evidence supports a direct or indirect relationship between Voxtalisib and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, emphasizing the importance of the 1A2 transporter in mediating this interaction.
